measurement_limits: All completed factual oracles pass. This is a three-fact synthetic ledger, not a general quality evaluation.
Auto/elastic expert placement varies between engine processes. Full first-logit rows and generated IDs are not claimed bitwise identical.
The earlier controlled 4k parity checks are separate and linked in prefix-cache-20261004.json.
The original ten-trial 10/20/30/40/50k plan was stopped at the user request to focus on supported prefix sizes; ten completed trials are NOT claimed.
The 50k trial has only cold and create measurements. Restore was interrupted and has no timing or pass result.
30k and 40k are successful normal-prefill fallbacks, not disk-cache speedups.
No artificial memory pressure, no OS filesystem-cache purge, no HTTP/client TTFT, no p99 or population estimate.
28k was not run: its snapshot size estimate exceeds 512 MiB for this geometry. 32768 is a token cap, not a guarantee every root up to it fits the byte cap.
